mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.7% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.7%).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100.0) with positive GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% q/q) indicates supply shock, increasing inflation expectations and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 and GDPC1 > 0.5% q/q (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) increase discount rates and reduce liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 150.0k) indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS > 150.0k (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts decline below 1500.0 (thousands) signals weakening demand in the housing sector, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1500.0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate decreases signal aggressive monetary tightening amid labor market strength, increasing recession risks and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 205.0) trigger central bank rate hikes, reducing real equity returns and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 205.0 (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).
